roles.description: Generalist software engineer who designs, builds and ships production systems at product companies and startups.
roles.name: Software Development Engineer

required_skills.reason: DSA is the core filter in SDE interviews and daily problem-solving.
Design rounds decide senior SDE offers at product companies.
Python is the default language for interviews, scripting and tooling.
Version control is how all professional code collaboration happens.
Most backend work touches databases and query optimization.
Servers run Linux; basics are needed for debugging and deployment.

roles.description: Builds user interfaces and client-side experiences for web applications, from layout to interactive features.
roles.name: Frontend Developer

required_skills.reason: Pixel-perfect, responsive, accessible UI is the job itself.
JavaScript powers all interactivity and modern frontend frameworks.
React dominates frontend job postings across India.
TypeScript is now expected in professional React codebases.
Frontend work ships through PRs and team workflows.

roles.description: Builds server-side APIs, services and data layers that power applications behind the scenes.
roles.name: Backend Developer

required_skills.reason: Node.js backends power countless startup APIs and services.
Data modeling and query performance are backend fundamentals.
Python backends are common in data-heavy and AI-adjacent products.
Backend engineers must design scalable, reliable services.
Services ship as containers in modern deployment pipelines.
Team development runs on Git workflows.
Production servers run Linux; debugging happens there.

roles.description: Turns business data into insights and dashboards that guide decisions across every industry.
roles.name: Data Analyst

required_skills.reason: SQL is the daily language for pulling and shaping data.
Core craft: cleaning, exploring and summarizing datasets.
Statistics separates real insights from noise.
Excel remains the lingua franca of business reporting.
Dashboards are how analysts deliver insights to stakeholders.
Python automates repetitive analysis and extends Excel and SQL.

roles.description: Builds, trains and deploys machine learning models into production AI products and services.
roles.name: ML Engineer

required_skills.reason: Python is the language of the entire ML ecosystem.
Core modeling skill for building ML products.
Deep learning powers vision, NLP and generative AI work.
Statistical rigor underpins model evaluation and experimentation.
Training data lives in databases and warehouses.
Interviews and efficient data pipelines both need DSA.
Models ship inside containers to production.
Training and serving happen on cloud infrastructure.

roles.description: Uses statistics and machine learning to answer business questions and build predictive models.
roles.name: Data Scientist

required_skills.reason: Python is the primary tool for data science workflows.
Statistical inference is the foundation of the role.
Predictive modeling is the core technical deliverable.
Exploratory analysis frames every data science project.
Data must be extracted and joined before it can be modeled.
Deep learning helps with unstructured data like text and images.

roles.description: Automates infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines and deployments so software ships fast and reliably.
roles.name: DevOps Engineer

required_skills.reason: Everything in DevOps runs on Linux servers.
Containers are the standard deployment unit.
Cloud platforms host the infrastructure you automate.
CI/CD pipelines are the core DevOps deliverable.
GitOps and pipeline work are built on Git fluency.
Python scripts glue automation together.

roles.description: Writes automated tests and frameworks that keep software quality high as products evolve quickly.
roles.name: QA Automation Engineer

required_skills.reason: Python drives Selenium and Playwright test frameworks.
Many enterprise test suites are written in Java.
Test data setup and verification need SQL.
Tests live in repos and run in CI.
CI runners and test environments run on Linux.

roles.description: Defends organizations by detecting threats, testing defenses and responding to security incidents.
roles.name: Cybersecurity Analyst

required_skills.reason: Security fundamentals are the base of all security work.
Security tooling and servers run on Linux.
Python automates scanning and log analysis.
Investigating breaches means querying logs and databases.
Security scripts and playbooks are versioned in Git.

roles.description: Builds native Android and cross-platform mobile apps used by millions of phone users.
roles.name: Mobile Developer

required_skills.reason: Java and Kotlin are the native languages of Android development.
Mobile interviews test DSA heavily.
App code is built and released through Git.
Build tools, emulators and CI run from the terminal.
Apps persist data in local and remote databases.

roles.description: Builds data pipelines and warehouses that make reliable data available to analysts and ML teams.
roles.name: Data Engineer

required_skills.reason: Python builds ETL pipelines and data tooling.
SQL is the language of warehouses and transformations.
Data platforms run on cloud storage and compute.
Pipeline components ship as containers.
Data infrastructure runs on Linux.
Understanding downstream analysis shapes good pipelines.

roles.description: Ships complete web applications end-to-end, from the user interface to the database.
roles.name: Full-Stack Developer

required_skills.reason: One language across the whole stack.
Frontend craft is half the role.
React is the standard frontend layer.
Node powers the backend layer.
Full-stack apps need database fluency.
Solo and team shipping runs on Git.
